Annotations.description: Drawn shapes over a photo's display copy. Never burnt into a file.

reason.description: Why. NAV stores it and shows it in the Online Számla portal.

resume_url.description:
A short-lived download link to the resume (about 15 minutes); None if it cannot be
signed.

notes.description: HR's own notes, e.g. from the phone interview.

ApplyForm.description: The application form as multipart/form-data. Documented as a schema, parsed by hand.

resume.description: A PDF, DOC, DOCX, ODT or RTF file, up to 10 MB.

company.description: Honeypot: real visitors leave it empty; a filled one is silently dropped.

enabled.description: False when no model is configured (AI_URL unset): the UI hides the assistant.

mode.description:
"attached" or "link", filled in when the email is sent. "embedded" means the file
travels as an inline image under `content_id`, referenced from the HTML as
`cid:…` rather than listed as an attachment.

content_id.description: Content-ID without brackets (`doc-42`); only set together with mode "embedded".

Attribution.description: What the website told us about one lead, plus the channel the server worked out.

gclid.description: Google Ads click id from the landing URL (0049): a won lead is reported back.

fbclid.description: Meta click id from the landing URL (0049).

recipients.description: Active, not suppressed, deduplicated: exactly who a blast would go to now.

BilledInvoice.description: An invoice with the order and partner it belongs to, for lists that span orders.

bucket.description:
The list it is on, worked out from the data: to_issue, issued, paid, archived,
stornoed, storno.

paid_at.description: When the customer paid. Set on issue for cash; marked by the office for transfer.

reminders_off.description: The office stopped the automatic payment reminders for this invoice.

reminders_sent.description: How many payment reminders went out.

paid_amount.description:
Received so far, in minor units (0049). Equal to the gross once paid; in between
on a partly paid invoice.

BilledProforma.description: A proforma with the order and partner it belongs to.

is_overdue.description:
Past due date and still open, measured against the caller's business day
(not UTC midnight — the whole point of this flag).

BlockerBody.description: Create requires `what`. On PATCH every field is optional; `null` clears.

share_of_waiting.description: Fraction (0–1) of all blocker waiting time in the period.

waiting_days.description: Sum of (resolved or now − created) across blockers, in days.

vehicles.description:
Vehicles of open jobs, and any vehicle still standing on a place. `location_id`
null: not placed yet.

BucketCount.description: How many invoices are on each list.

BulkAction.description:
One bulk operation over a ticked set of leads. Stage changes run the same per-lead
rules as one-by-one changes, so an invalid transition skips that lead rather than
failing the whole batch.

url.description:
The secret subscription link (Google Calendar: "From URL"; Outlook: "Subscribe from
web"). None until one is made.

Capability.description:
Every authenticated user may read orders, partners, leads, images and reports.
Capabilities cover everything beyond reading. The role gives a default set; an admin can
grant any [`Capability::grantable`] one to a single user on top of it (`users.permissions`).

ChainStep.description:
One document in the invoice's chain at NAV.

The sidecar speaks NAV's camelCase; this API does not. Restating the four fields the
screen uses keeps the contract in one shape rather than leaving a camelCase island in
the middle of it.

original_invoice_number.description: The document this one modifies, on a storno or a correction.

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first; the last one is the user's question.

due_days.description: Due this many days after the checklist is started.
Due this many days after the checklist is started (0–365).

user_deactivated.description: The linked account was switched off.

mentions.description: The people named in it, who were notified.

mention_ids.description: The users named in the text (`@Név`). Each is notified once.

suggestions.description:
Suggested verdict per check-in damage: same zone + same type as a
check-out damage reads as pre-existing, anything else as new. The
inspector still confirms or dismisses each one.

body_markdown.description:
The body is Markdown: rendered to HTML for sending, kept as written for the text
part and the inbox. Templates stay plain text — Markdown and `{{variables}}` mix
badly when values contain asterisks, so a template plus this flag is refused.

hero.description:
Optional shout across the top of the HTML part (the quotation letter's band).
The text part never carries it.

embed_document_ids.description:
Documents shown inline: write `![alt](doc:ID)` in Markdown and pick the file here.
Sent as inline parts under `cid:doc-ID`, never as download links.

reply_to_inbound_id.description:
Answer to this received message (an inbound email's id): the letter carries
In-Reply-To and References, so it lands in the customer's thread (0049).

confirmed.description: False for an unknown, already used or expired link.

ContactBody.description: Create requires `name`. On PATCH every field is optional; `null` clears.

ContactHit.description: A person at a partner company.

ConversationItem.description: One letter in a conversation: ours (out) or the customer's (in), oldest first.
